o.text: From Arabic عَلَف (ʕalaf). Doublet of alaf.
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish قومق (qovmaq), from Proto-Turkic *kob- (“to follow, chase”). Cognate with Turkish kovmak etc.
Borrowed from Arabic قَيْد (qayd). Doublet of qandal.
From Arabic أَدَبِيّ (ʔadabiyy). By surface analysis, ədəb + -i.
Borrowed from Arabic سَمَاوِيّ (samāwiyy). By surface analysis, səma (“sky”) + -vi.
